notes: ADMINISTRATIVE COUNT, not a modelled stock and not an enforcement flow: MVD register of nationals of post-Soviet/CIS states residing in Russia without valid documentation, as at late 2020. LOWER BOUND: source states 'more than 1.2 million'; recorded here as 1,200,000.
